newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Changes to Worldwide flight schedules.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Changes to Worldwide flight schedules.

text.p: This is a Reuters diary of changes to worldwide flight schedules.
If you wish to contribute to the diary contact: Air Cargo Newsroom, Tel: +44 171 542 7706 Fax: +44 171 542 5017.
**DECEMBER 15**
- Air Lanka adds fourth-weekly Colombo-Frankfurt flight.
- Air France starts third-weekly service to Hanoi, via Bangkok.
**DECEMBER 17**
- Adria Airways (Slovenia) restarts one-weekly return flight to Dubrovnik, Croatia.
**DECEMBER 20**
- Vanguard discontinues service to Pheonix
**JANUARY 6**
- SAS starts two new routing links to Billund, in Jutland, west Denmark, with Frankfurt and Oslo.
*JANUARY 7**
- United airlines adds new nonstop flights to both Boston and San Diego, California.
- Hawaiian Airlines form a code-sharing agreement with Reno Air.
**JANUARY 9**
- American West begins services to Cleveland, Ohio, with two daily flights from Phoenix and one per day from Las Vegas.
- Continental to start non-stop flights to Guayaquil, Ecuador.
**FEBRUARY** (date to be confirmed)
- British Airways World Cargo starts regular cargo charter flights between London Gatwick and Tel Aviv.
**FEBRUARY 15**
- Taiwan halts direct flights to South Africa to epanlise Pretoria's plan to sever displomatic ties.
**MARCH 17**
- British Airways switches 13 weekly flights to Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Columbia, Mexico and Venezuela to Gatwick's north terminal from Heathrow.
**MARCH 29**
- USAir ends code-share agreement with British Airways.
**APRIL 1**
- Transaero starts code-sharing programme with American Airlines.
**JUNE 1**
Northwest Airlines starts a service to Delhi and Mumbai.
Lan Chile to increase flights to Germany by 50 percent to six a week after obtaining two new Frankfurt slots. Current schedule is Frankfurt-Madrid-Santiago four times a week with a Boeing 767-300.
**JUNE 15**

- Air Canada and Lufthansa start a code sharing service operated by Air Canada's Boeing 767s between Montreal and Frankfurt consisting of five non-stop flights a week in each direction plus an additional two on the remaining days of the week that will fly via Halifax.
**JUNE 17**
- Air Canada begins non-stop service between Toronto and Osaka.
**JUNE 19**
- LTU International Airways (Germany holiday airline) launches weekly services from Dusseldorf to Bergen and Lakselv in Norway.
**JUNE 29**
- Air China starts flights from Beijing and Shanghai to Los Angeles.
**OCTOBER**
- Swissair begins scheduled services to Vietnam with twice-weekly flights to Ho Chi Minh City, the former Saigon.
